description: AppLovin Ads performance: impressions, clicks, CTR, spend, sales, ROAS and checkout revenue by day, campaign, creative set or country. Works with the Reporting Key alone, which every AppLovin account has. Web reports reach back 90 days, app 45; UTC. Read-only, free.

columns.description: e.g. day, campaign, campaign_id_external, creative_set, country, impressions, clicks, ctr, cost, sales, roas_7d, chka_usd_7d

having.description: server-side numeric filter, e.g. "cost > 0 AND roas_7d < 1": report columns, numbers, > < >= <= = !=, AND, OR, parentheses (AppLovin warns it slows the report)

notZero.description: drop rows whose metrics are all zero

offset.description: rows to skip, for paging past the limit

name: applovin_ads_report
title: AppLovin Ads performance report
